claim: The GUI session-event poll now consumes at most 256 FIFO events per callback and requests another repaint after a full batch. The existing event handler and Stop suppression rule remain unchanged.
validation: Required Rust format, strict Clippy, workspace tests (472 passed, 0 failed, 3 ignored), and x64/i686 app and observer builds passed. Focused tests confirmed that a live producer's 257th event stays queued after the first batch and that acknowledgements and Stopped remain in FIFO order across two batches. All 864 compiled source hashes stayed stable; gui.rs was the sole change from the accepted Macro producer, and ten private runtime file hashes remained pinned.
limits: This is a source-and-test acceptance of a finite event-count and temporary batch-allocation bound. No new native cohort was run. Per-event processing time, total channel backlog, Stop or terminal-ACK latency, and general GUI responsiveness were not established. The historical GUI-stall P1 remains OPEN; this change neither identifies nor proves a fix for its cause.
